Rank n−3 and implicit-function theorem show the local zero set equals the smooth circle manifold; normal-bundle Taylor estimate proves optimal nonlinear modulus. Explicit convex small-u hypotheses and n=4 boundary handled. Standalone checker executed; finite numerical cases supplement, not establish, proof.
